remarks: 2 or 3 Bedroom End Unit and quiet location in a Stamford's best private and sought after community living ! Mid city and walk to houses of worship. Bright and Airy 4 level home. Amazing location! Large living room and dining / living room areas, with sliders to private patio that opens to a large backyard! Cozy up with Fireplace! Eat in Kitchen area + bay window in kitchen. High ceilings w/ Recessed lights. Set within 19 acres featuring beautifully manicured grounds, away from the road. Bright with natural light pouring in with large windows + skylight. 3rd floor room with doors that can be a lovely 3rd bedroom, with full closet + storage! Secret room in one of the bedrooms that can be an additional playroom / office / study or flex space. Hardwood floors throughout the home + finished basement for added space. Sliders to Oversized deck off of Primary bedroom suite + 2nd bedroom!! Community is centrally located, with Club House and In-ground swimming pool. Highest and Best by 11am on Tuesday April 21st
